# Joko Widodo, 2024, 1B.2 Research Note

Assessment: **responsible / restrained nuclear rhetoric**. Within the 2024 search budget, I found repeated anti-nuclear and de-escalatory public messaging, and no reliable 2024 evidence that Jokowi used reckless nuclear threats, brinkmanship, apocalyptic framing, or normalization of nuclear use.

## Accepted claims

| Valence | Title | Publisher / date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Favorable | [Indonesia discusses nuclear test ban treaty ratification with CTBTO](https://en.antaranews.com/news/316995/indonesia-discusses-nuclear-test-ban-treaty-ratification-with-ctbto) | ANTARA News, 2024-06-26 | https://en.antaranews.com/news/316995/indonesia-discusses-nuclear-test-ban-treaty-ratification-with-ctbto | Indonesia advanced ratification work on the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty and framed it as part of reducing risk in an increasingly uncertain security environment. This is careful, anti-escalatory nuclear rhetoric, not brinkmanship. | `1B.2`, `1B.1` |
| Favorable | [Indonesia calls for firm ASEAN stance on nuclear disarmament](https://en.antaranews.com/news/319647/indonesia-calls-for-firm-asean-stance-on-nuclear-disarmament) | ANTARA News, 2024-07-24 | https://en.antaranews.com/news/319647/indonesia-calls-for-firm-asean-stance-on-nuclear-disarmament | Indonesia urged ASEAN to hold a firm line on disarmament and warned that weakening commitments by nuclear-armed states pushes the world farther from a nuclear-free order. This directly reflects responsible anti-normalization rhetoric. | `1B.2`, `1B.1` |
| Favorable | [Indonesia joins countries prohibiting nuclear weapons](https://en.antaranews.com/news/327307/indonesia-joins-countries-prohibiting-nuclear-weapons) | ANTARA News, 2024-09-25 | https://en.antaranews.com/news/327307/indonesia-joins-countries-prohibiting-nuclear-weapons | Indonesia formally deposited its instrument of ratification for the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons at the UN. That is strong evidence against any rhetorical normalization of nuclear use. | `1B.2`, `1B.1` |
| Favorable | [Presiden Jokowi Tegaskan Dialog Adalah Solusi Terbaik untuk Konflik di Timur Tengah](https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-tegaskan-dialog-adalah-solusi-terbaik-untuk-konflik-di-timur-tengah/) | Presidential Secretariat of the Republic of Indonesia, 2024-10-05 | https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-tegaskan-dialog-adalah-solusi-terbaik-untuk-konflik-di-timur-tengah/ | Jokowi publicly said dialogue was the best way to reduce escalation in the Middle East and urged all sides to restrain themselves. This is not nuclear-specific, but it is plainly responsible crisis rhetoric. | `1B.2` |
| Favorable | [Indonesia Condemns Israeli Attacks on Gaza, Lebanon, UN Peacekeepers](https://setkab.go.id/en/indonesia-condemns-israeli-attacks-on-gaza-lebanon-un-peacekeepers/) | Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia, 2024-10-15 | https://setkab.go.id/en/indonesia-condemns-israeli-attacks-on-gaza-lebanon-un-peacekeepers/ | Jokowi condemned attacks on civilians and UN peacekeepers and called for restraint and an end to armed conflict. Again, not nuclear-specific, but it is consistent with restrained, non-apocalyptic public rhetoric. | `1B.2` |

## Search gap

I did **not** find reliable 2024 evidence that Jokowi:
- issued reckless nuclear threats,
- used apocalyptic nuclear language,
- engaged in nuclear brinkmanship,
- or normalized the use of nuclear weapons.

That absence is the main result here. The 2024 record I found is overwhelmingly on the opposite side: disarmament, treaty ratification, and escalation restraint. If you want, I can next turn this into a tighter scoring-ready evidence list with only the most directly probative items.
